derivation.indices: For image [B,C,H,W], p divides H,W. patchify changes [B,C,H/p,p,W/p,p] to [B,H/p,W/p,C,p,p], then merges patch row/column and channel/local row/local column. With q=W/p: n=patch_row*q+patch_column; k=c*p²+local_y*p+local_x; output[b,n,k]=input[b,c,patch_row*p+local_y,patch_column*p+local_x]. This is a bijection; unpatchify uses the inverse axes (0,3,1,4,2,5).
derivation.p4: 16/4=4 per row; 4×4=16 patches; 3×4×4=48 values; 16×48=3×16×16=768 scalar values per image.
derivation.p8: 16/8=2 per row; 2×2=4 patches; 3×8×8=192 values; 4×192=768 values per image.
derivation.card_counterexample: Column-order permutation pi=[0,2,1,3] is its own inverse: forward uses P_pi after row-first serialization and inverse uses P_pi before reconstruction. Rounds trips are exact while second element is c rather than b. This verifies the source text limitation.
